title: Enhancing the Bioavailability and Bioactivity of Curcumin for ... - MDPI
abstract: For nanoformulations with increased bioavailability, adverse side effects that can come from the higher level of curcumin itself, or the other components in the formulation can be of concern: however, as recently reviewed, most of the curcumin formulations studied did not show issues with safety, tolerability, or efficacy in clinical trials [[33](https://www.mdpi.com/2076-3921/13/3/331#B33-antioxidants-13-00331)]. **Table 3.** Curcumin formulations with increased bioavailability in humans [[52](https://www.mdpi.com/2076-3921/13/3/331#B52-antioxidants-13-00331)].
